setup: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE users AS SELECT i::BIGINT AS user_id, (20 + i % 50)::INTEGER AS age, ['US', 'DE', 'IN'][1 + i % 3] AS country FROM range(1500) t(i)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE orders AS SELECT i::BIGINT AS order_id, (i % 1500)::BIGINT AS user_id, (10 + (i % 100) * 1.5)::DOUBLE AS price, TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01' + to_days((i % 420)::INTEGER) AS ts FROM range(6000) t(i)
input.pql: PREDICT COUNT(orders.*, 0, 30, days) > 0 FOR EACH users.user_id

why: Snowflake entity-table sampling. Compare source membership and sample size, rather than exact sampled identities, because warehouse sampling is not seeded.
source: Correctness case snowflake.sampled.entity-table using the shop fixture.
